claims.text: Variables and arrays live in memory, which is cleared when the program ends, so a file stores data in secondary storage where it is kept after the program ends and can be read again later, by the same program or another one.

claims.text: A text file is opened with OPENFILE and a mode: READ reads lines from the start, WRITE creates the file afresh so anything already in it is lost, and APPEND adds new lines to the end of an existing file.

claims.text: EOF(<file>) returns TRUE when there are no more lines to read, so a loop that reads a whole file tests NOT EOF(<file>) before each READFILE, and every file that is opened is closed with CLOSEFILE and the same file name.
